posts.text: Over the last 12 years, India has witnessed many transformations and at the core of these changes is the welfare of the poor. Dedication and the spirit of service have been our invaluable capital for nation-building. #12YearsOfSeva
posts.caption: Over the last 12 years, India has witnessed many transformations and at the core of these changes is the welfare of the poor. Dedication and the spirit of service have been our invaluable capital for nation-building. #12YearsOfSeva

posts.text: 12 years of transformative governance under PM @narendramodi. From Jan Dhan accounts and Direct Benefit Transfer to Swachh Bharat, PM Awas Yojana, Jal Jeevan Mission and Ayushman Bharat — every initiative driven by dignity and opportunity for all.
posts.caption: 12 years of transformative governance under PM @narendramodi. From Jan Dhan accounts and Direct Benefit Transfer to Swachh Bharat, PM Awas Yojana, Jal Jeevan Mission and Ayushman Bharat — every initiative driven by dignity and opportunity for all.

posts.text: Honourable Shri Narendra Modi ji took the oath of office as Prime Minister for the third consecutive time on this very day. Whether it is providing free rations to 80 crore people or launching over 90 airports — Modi ji has served the nation tirelessly through 12 years without taking even a single day off.
posts.caption: Honourable Shri Narendra Modi ji took the oath of office as Prime Minister for the third consecutive time on this very day. Whether it is providing free rations to 80 crore people or launching over 90 airports — Modi ji has served the nation tirelessly through 12 years without taking even a single day off.

posts.text: The real story of these 12 years is what the BJP government doesn't talk about — rising unemployment, growing inequality, and farmers still struggling. India deserves a government that listens, not one that lectures.
posts.caption: The real story of these 12 years is what the BJP government doesn't talk about — rising unemployment, growing inequality, and farmers still struggling. India deserves a government that listens, not one that lectures.

posts.text: We are in discussions with ISRO to deploy a dedicated satellite for weather monitoring in Uttar Pradesh. Timely and accurate weather information is critical for our farmers and disaster response. The new Regional Meteorological Centre in Lucknow will strengthen our capabilities.
posts.caption: We are in discussions with ISRO to deploy a dedicated satellite for weather monitoring in Uttar Pradesh. Timely and accurate weather information is critical for our farmers and disaster response. The new Regional Meteorological Centre in Lucknow will strengthen our capabilities.

posts.text: 12 years of Modi government means 12 years of broken promises. Delhi showed what real governance looks like — world-class schools, mohalla clinics, free electricity and water. That is the model India needs.
posts.caption: 12 years of Modi government means 12 years of broken promises. Delhi showed what real governance looks like — world-class schools, mohalla clinics, free electricity and water. That is the model India needs.

posts.text: India's foreign policy and the functioning of MEA have undergone a remarkable transformation over the past 12 years. Passports are easier, evacuations from conflict zones stronger, and India's global standing is at an all-time high. Heading to Bulgaria and Finland for key diplomatic engagements.
posts.caption: India's foreign policy and the functioning of MEA have undergone a remarkable transformation over the past 12 years. Passports are easier, evacuations from conflict zones stronger, and India's global standing is at an all-time high. Heading to Bulgaria and Finland for key diplomatic engagements.

posts.text: The guiding principle of PM Modi-led government over the past 12 years has been 'Jan Seva Se Jan Shakti.' Every initiative has aimed to empower citizens through inclusion, innovation and opportunity. Met West Bengal CM to discuss accelerating the state's development journey.
posts.caption: The guiding principle of PM Modi-led government over the past 12 years has been 'Jan Seva Se Jan Shakti.' Every initiative has aimed to empower citizens through inclusion, innovation and opportunity. Met West Bengal CM to discuss accelerating the state's development journey.

posts.text: All LPG trade conducted by Adani entities is fully compliant with applicable domestic and international laws, including US sanctions regulations. We maintain rigorous due diligence and KYC standards with every supplier. The facts speak for themselves.
posts.caption: All LPG trade conducted by Adani entities is fully compliant with applicable domestic and international laws, including US sanctions regulations. We maintain rigorous due diligence and KYC standards with every supplier. The facts speak for themselves.

posts.text: Proud to announce a Rs 151 crore grant to ICT — celebrating Professor Sharma's extraordinary legacy. Education and innovation are the foundations of a self-reliant India. Reliance remains committed to building world-class digital and educational infrastructure.
posts.caption: Proud to announce a Rs 151 crore grant to ICT — celebrating Professor Sharma's extraordinary legacy. Education and innovation are the foundations of a self-reliant India. Reliance remains committed to building world-class digital and educational infrastructure.

posts.text: I have always believed that a business should create value for the community it serves. India's journey is one of resilience and enterprise, and I remain optimistic about what our young entrepreneurs will build next.
posts.caption: I have always believed that a business should create value for the community it serves. India's journey is one of resilience and enterprise, and I remain optimistic about what our young entrepreneurs will build next.

posts.text: Presented Gallantry Awards at the Defence Investiture Ceremony 2026. The courage and professionalism of our Armed Forces, CAPFs and Police serve as an inspiration to the nation. Their unwavering commitment to safeguarding our sovereignty fills every Indian with pride.
posts.caption: Presented Gallantry Awards at the Defence Investiture Ceremony 2026. The courage and professionalism of our Armed Forces, CAPFs and Police serve as an inspiration to the nation. Their unwavering commitment to safeguarding our sovereignty fills every Indian with pride.

posts.text: I have just been informed by our Great Military that last night the Iranians shot down one of our highly sophisticated Apache Helicopters while patrolling over the Strait of Hormuz. There were two pilots involved, both are safe and uninjured. Nevertheless, the United States must, of necessity, respond to this attack. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.text: The Conservative Party must rebuild and refocus on what matters — lower taxes, less regulation, more freedom and strong defence. We need to offer a credible alternative that takes votes back and fights for the values that built Britain.
posts.caption: The Conservative Party must rebuild and refocus on what matters — lower taxes, less regulation, more freedom and strong defence. We need to offer a credible alternative that takes votes back and fights for the values that built Britain.

posts.text: Humbled to win the Republican nomination for Ohio Governor. The field cleared and the people spoke. Now it's time to bring real leadership to the Buckeye State — cut bureaucracy, restore excellence, and put Ohio families first. On to November!
posts.caption: Humbled to win the Republican nomination for Ohio Governor. The field cleared and the people spoke. Now it's time to bring real leadership to the Buckeye State — cut bureaucracy, restore excellence, and put Ohio families first. On to November!

posts.text: Proud to continue supporting initiatives that empower communities and expand opportunity. As Second Lady, my focus remains on education, legal access, and the American families who drive this nation forward.
posts.caption: Proud to continue supporting initiatives that empower communities and expand opportunity. As Second Lady, my focus remains on education, legal access, and the American families who drive this nation forward.

posts.text: No tolerance for violence against law enforcement. The FBI is focused on protecting Americans from threats foreign and domestic. We are restoring accountability and putting the safety of the American people first.
posts.caption: No tolerance for violence against law enforcement. The FBI is focused on protecting Americans from threats foreign and domestic. We are restoring accountability and putting the safety of the American people first.

posts.text: The AI policy landscape is evolving fast. Working to ensure America leads in AI while keeping markets competitive and innovation open. The best policy is built on deep technical understanding, not fear.
posts.caption: The AI policy landscape is evolving fast. Working to ensure America leads in AI while keeping markets competitive and innovation open. The best policy is built on deep technical understanding, not fear.

posts.text: The World Bank is accelerating its mission to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity. We are reforming faster, lending more, and partnering with the private sector to deliver results where they matter most — in developing nations.
posts.caption: The World Bank is accelerating its mission to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity. We are reforming faster, lending more, and partnering with the private sector to deliver results where they matter most — in developing nations.

posts.text: Where foreign states are found to be engaging in activity that threatens lives or undermines our democratic institutions, we must ensure that such actions have consequences. We will not tolerate hostile actors paying petty criminals to do their dirty work.
posts.caption: Where foreign states are found to be engaging in activity that threatens lives or undermines our democratic institutions, we must ensure that such actions have consequences. We will not tolerate hostile actors paying petty criminals to do their dirty work.

posts.text: Australia stands with our allies for stability and peace in the Indo-Pacific. Our partnerships with India, Japan and the Quad are stronger than ever. We remain focused on creating opportunities for Australians while engaging constructively with the region.
posts.caption: Australia stands with our allies for stability and peace in the Indo-Pacific. Our partnerships with India, Japan and the Quad are stronger than ever. We remain focused on creating opportunities for Australians while engaging constructively with the region.

posts.text: We commend President Zelenskiy's call for an end to the war, negotiated by diplomatic means. Europe stands united — with the UK and Germany — in supporting a ceasefire and direct dialogue between Ukraine and Russia with active European participation.
posts.caption: We commend President Zelenskiy's call for an end to the war, negotiated by diplomatic means. Europe stands united — with the UK and Germany — in supporting a ceasefire and direct dialogue between Ukraine and Russia with active European participation.

posts.text: Dubai continues to set the pace for innovation and economic diversification. Our vision is clear — to be the world's most future-ready city. We welcome global talent, startups and enterprises to build the next chapter with us.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to set the pace for innovation and economic diversification. Our vision is clear — to be the world's most future-ready city. We welcome global talent, startups and enterprises to build the next chapter with us.

posts.text: ASML should be treasured. It is arguably the greatest company in Europe. Building orbital AI data centers is not a super hard problem compared to the things we already do — a lot of this is technology we've already made for Starlink V3 satellites. SpaceX IPO this Friday.
posts.caption: ASML should be treasured. It is arguably the greatest company in Europe. Building orbital AI data centers is not a super hard problem compared to the things we already do — a lot of this is technology we've already made for Starlink V3 satellites. SpaceX IPO this Friday.

posts.text: Meta AI is now used by over a billion people. We're continuing to invest in open-source AI with Llama and building the next generation of AR/VR experiences. The future is open, and we're building it together.
posts.caption: Meta AI is now used by over a billion people. We're continuing to invest in open-source AI with Llama and building the next generation of AR/VR experiences. The future is open, and we're building it together.

posts.text: Excited to partner with Apple to bring Private Cloud Compute to Google Cloud. Privacy and AI can coexist — and this partnership proves it. Also: AI won't destroy career opportunities for new graduates. It will be a powerful equaliser.
posts.caption: Excited to partner with Apple to bring Private Cloud Compute to Google Cloud. Privacy and AI can coexist — and this partnership proves it. Also: AI won't destroy career opportunities for new graduates. It will be a powerful equaliser.

posts.text: AI is fundamentally reshaping every industry. At Microsoft, we are building the infrastructure for an AI-first world — from Azure to Copilot. Every organization will need an AI strategy, and we're here to help them build it.
posts.caption: AI is fundamentally reshaping every industry. At Microsoft, we are building the infrastructure for an AI-first world — from Azure to Copilot. Every organization will need an AI strategy, and we're here to help them build it.

posts.text: We filed confidentially for an IPO. It may be a while — there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. Our three big goals: build an automated AI researcher, accelerate economic growth, and give everyone on Earth a personal AGI.
posts.caption: We filed confidentially for an IPO. It may be a while — there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. Our three big goals: build an automated AI researcher, accelerate economic growth, and give everyone on Earth a personal AGI.

posts.text: Expanding Private Cloud Compute beyond Apple data centers — partnering with Google and NVIDIA to run Apple Intelligence workloads while maintaining our core privacy and security guarantees. The future of AI is private.
posts.caption: Expanding Private Cloud Compute beyond Apple data centers — partnering with Google and NVIDIA to run Apple Intelligence workloads while maintaining our core privacy and security guarantees. The future of AI is private.

posts.text: Whatever happened to the stock market, you should be very happy because now you can buy at a discount. Everyone should be very excited. Humanoid robots are very very close to industrial reality. We just announced a multi-year AI memory chip deal with SK Hynix.
posts.caption: Whatever happened to the stock market, you should be very happy because now you can buy at a discount. Everyone should be very excited. Humanoid robots are very very close to industrial reality. We just announced a multi-year AI memory chip deal with SK Hynix.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — is now a global model. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion at population scale. India is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — is now a global model. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion at population scale. India is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

posts.text: AI will be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. But we must ensure its benefits reach everyone, especially in health and education. The Gates Foundation is investing heavily in AI for global health — from drug discovery to diagnostics in low-income countries.
posts.caption: AI will be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. But we must ensure its benefits reach everyone, especially in health and education. The Gates Foundation is investing heavily in AI for global health — from drug discovery to diagnostics in low-income countries.

posts.text: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI with watsonx. The enterprises that adopt AI-first strategies now will define the next decade of business. Hybrid cloud and AI together are the foundation of the modern enterprise.
posts.caption: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI with watsonx. The enterprises that adopt AI-first strategies now will define the next decade of business. Hybrid cloud and AI together are the foundation of the modern enterprise.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not opposites — they're multipliers. Adobe Firefly is empowering millions of creators to do more than ever. We're building AI that augments human imagination, not replaces it.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not opposites — they're multipliers. Adobe Firefly is empowering millions of creators to do more than ever. We're building AI that augments human imagination, not replaces it.

posts.text: Building the future of AI-native products. The next generation of technology leaders will be defined not by the models they train, but by the products they build and the problems they solve.
posts.caption: Building the future of AI-native products. The next generation of technology leaders will be defined not by the models they train, but by the products they build and the problems they solve.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe in the power of timeless craft meeting modern innovation. Investing in our people, our artisans, and our communities is how we build a luxury house that endures for generations.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe in the power of timeless craft meeting modern innovation. Investing in our people, our artisans, and our communities is how we build a luxury house that endures for generations.

posts.text: At FedEx, we are using AI and automation to transform logistics globally. Our network connects 220+ countries and territories, and AI-driven optimization is making deliveries faster, smarter, and more sustainable than ever.
posts.caption: At FedEx, we are using AI and automation to transform logistics globally. Our network connects 220+ countries and territories, and AI-driven optimization is making deliveries faster, smarter, and more sustainable than ever.

posts.text: What a season with RCB! Topped the IPL batting averages at 128 this year. The team showed incredible fight. Now it's time to reset and focus on what's ahead — there's always more to achieve.
posts.caption: What a season with RCB! Topped the IPL batting averages at 128 this year. The team showed incredible fight. Now it's time to reset and focus on what's ahead — there's always more to achieve.

posts.text: IPL 2026 was a great learning experience. Scored 78 as my highest this season. Mumbai Indians showed resilience throughout. Now looking ahead to the international schedule — the hunger never stops.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 was a great learning experience. Scored 78 as my highest this season. Mumbai Indians showed resilience throughout. Now looking ahead to the international schedule — the hunger never stops.

posts.text: Another IPL season done. The discussions about CSK's future and my role will happen in due time. For now, grateful for every moment on the field and the love from fans across the world.
posts.caption: Another IPL season done. The discussions about CSK's future and my role will happen in due time. For now, grateful for every moment on the field and the love from fans across the world.

posts.text: The IPL is always an incredible competition. Every season pushes you to get better. The focus now shifts to Team India duties. Nothing beats wearing the national jersey.
posts.caption: The IPL is always an incredible competition. Every season pushes you to get better. The focus now shifts to Team India duties. Nothing beats wearing the national jersey.

posts.text: IPL 2026 — gave it everything. Speculation about my future will sort itself out. Right now, I'm focused on fitness and getting ready for what's next. The best is yet to come.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 — gave it everything. Speculation about my future will sort itself out. Right now, I'm focused on fitness and getting ready for what's next. The best is yet to come.

posts.text: The IPL 2026 season gave us some unforgettable moments — a 15-year-old breaking Chris Gayle's six-hitting record is extraordinary. Cricket in India keeps producing talent that amazes the world. The future is bright.
posts.caption: The IPL 2026 season gave us some unforgettable moments — a 15-year-old breaking Chris Gayle's six-hitting record is extraordinary. Cricket in India keeps producing talent that amazes the world. The future is bright.

posts.text: Indian cricket continues to set benchmarks globally. The depth of talent coming through the IPL is remarkable. Confident India will do well on the international stage — the system is producing world-class players year after year.
posts.caption: Indian cricket continues to set benchmarks globally. The depth of talent coming through the IPL is remarkable. Confident India will do well on the international stage — the system is producing world-class players year after year.

posts.text: IPL 2026 season concludes with record-breaking performances! A 15-year-old surpassed Chris Gayle's record for most sixes in a single edition. Indian cricket continues to grow in reach and quality.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 season concludes with record-breaking performances! A 15-year-old surpassed Chris Gayle's record for most sixes in a single edition. Indian cricket continues to grow in reach and quality.

posts.text: Bangladesh crush Australia by 86 runs to end a 21-year ODI drought. Cricket at its finest — the game continues to produce stunning upsets and compelling stories from across the world.
posts.caption: Bangladesh crush Australia by 86 runs to end a 21-year ODI drought. Cricket at its finest — the game continues to produce stunning upsets and compelling stories from across the world.

posts.text: What a season! IPL 2026 delivered record-breaking innings, a 15-year-old sensation smashing sixes records, and edge-of-the-seat knockout finishes. See you next season!
posts.caption: What a season! IPL 2026 delivered record-breaking innings, a 15-year-old sensation smashing sixes records, and edge-of-the-seat knockout finishes. See you next season!

posts.text: Training hard for the Diamond League season. Every throw is a step toward pushing my personal best even further. India's athletics revolution is just getting started.

posts.text: Working on my game every single day. Badminton at the highest level demands constant evolution. Excited about the upcoming tournaments and ready to compete at my best. Jai Hind!
posts.caption: Working on my game every single day. Badminton at the highest level demands constant evolution. Excited about the upcoming tournaments and ready to compete at my best. Jai Hind!

posts.text: Life after professional tennis has been an incredible journey. Focused on mentoring the next generation of Indian tennis talent and building opportunities for young athletes. The court taught me everything about resilience.
posts.caption: Life after professional tennis has been an incredible journey. Focused on mentoring the next generation of Indian tennis talent and building opportunities for young athletes. The court taught me everything about resilience.

posts.text: Continuing to prepare for the highest levels of chess competition. India's chess legacy is growing stronger with each generation. Honored to represent the country and inspired by the support from fans.
posts.caption: Continuing to prepare for the highest levels of chess competition. India's chess legacy is growing stronger with each generation. Honored to represent the country and inspired by the support from fans.

posts.text: Indian football continues to grow. The passion of our fans, the quality of the ISL, and the development at grassroots level give me hope. This sport has so much potential in India — we just need to keep believing and working.
